name: one
description: Use ONE boards, operational workspaces, and authoritative GeoTech brand standards from Codex with per-user OAuth and live permissions.

interface.shortDescription: Work with ONE and GeoTech brand standards.
interface.longDescription: Connect Codex to ONE using your Google account. ONE applies live permissions for every board, project-planning, Procurement, Remote Machine, redacted administration audit, Hardware asset, private document, Finance, protected backup, and brand-standard tool call, including owner-only sensitive backup export and explicit People-document access. Hiring remains ONE UI-only.
defaultPrompt: List the ONE boards I can access.
Get the GeoTech brand standards before designing a presentation.
Find recent contacts in ONE matching a company name.
Create an item in ONE after confirming the board and fields.
List Hardware assets and their private documents that I can access.
List recent ONE backup metadata without exporting protected data.
Audit ONE access and API-key metadata without exposing secrets.
Create a Procurement request after showing its ordered approval chain.
Show a project's statuses and sprints before changing its planning structure.
